items.issue: Allegations about 'Wang Shuiniu', sexual conduct, pregnancy or abortion, manipulation and the scale of contacts are unverified online disclosures. Mikey himself says official confirmation was lacking.
items.disposition: Keep all controversy facts and attributed messages do_not_generalize; do not repeat them as verified biography.

items.issue: The episode repeatedly generalizes Chinese men, Chinese women, Western men, foreigners and East Asian culture without comparative evidence.
items.disposition: Do not convert nationality, race or gender comparisons into factual group profiles or individual predictions.

items.issue: The source uses demeaning labels, racialized examples and contemptuous language for groups and individuals.
items.disposition: Do not reproduce slurs or humiliation as the guide's voice; retain only the underlying source analysis with explicit attribution.

items.issue: Directness and confidence could be misread as permission to ignore another person's refusal, while the quoted third-party conduct includes blunt dismissal and disputed sexual allegations.
items.disposition: Any future use must pair self-expression with accepting refusal and respecting both parties; do not derive escalation tactics from the third-party example.

items.issue: Cropped posts, profile images and private-message-style screenshots may contain personal data and do not establish authorship, completeness, authenticity or publication consent.
items.disposition: Do not copy private-looking images into a formal package without privacy review and redaction; do not quote text that is unreadable or lacks provenance.

items.issue: The claim that first impressions reveal strength through body language and posture, and that women react uniformly to these signals, is presented without supporting behavioral evidence.
items.disposition: Retain as Mikey's model only, with no diagnostic certainty about an individual woman.

items.issue: Historical-colonial explanation, tourism anecdotes and the English-direction example are used to infer present-day psychological hierarchy without sourcing or comparative data.
items.disposition: Keep context_only or do_not_generalize; do not present as established social science.

items.issue: The narration says a woman's selection proves the man has attraction, but selection alone does not reveal motive, consent history, relationship quality or causal mechanism.
items.disposition: Attribute the inference to Mikey and do not infer private motives from the outcome alone.

items.issue: The phrase 'self-confidence is innate like a human right' is rhetorical and may conceal clinically relevant causes of low confidence or anxiety.
items.disposition: Use only as motivational framing; do not make mental-health claims or blame a person for persistent anxiety.

items.issue: Automatic ASR has repeated pronoun, name and term errors, including 王水牛, 慕强, 国男/龟男, 崇洋媚外, 普信 and 宁为玉碎不为瓦全; the final tail is low quality.
items.disposition: Do not quote uncertain wording without audio review. Normalize only terms that are clear from title cards, readable visuals and continuous context.

items.issue: The generated ASR originally extended 3.72 seconds beyond the audited media duration.
items.disposition: Resolved mechanically: removed two wholly out-of-range hallucinated segments and clipped S00607 to 848.805 seconds. The remaining low-quality outro is excluded from substantive use.
